case_title: Virendra Singh v. State of Madhya Pradesh
aggravating_circumstances: Pre-arranged plan, use of weapons, physical violence
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Section 302 read with Section 34 IPC
neutral_facts: The accused, along with his father and brother, went to the house of the deceased with weapons. They had a verbal altercation and started beating the son of the deceased. When the deceased intervened, the brother of the accused, upon exhortation from his father, fired at the deceased, resulting in his death. The prosecution witnesses provided detailed accounts of the incident, including the use of weapons, the beating of the deceased's family members, and the subsequent shooting of the deceased. The trial court convicted all three accused under Section 302 read with Section 34 IPC, and the High Court upheld this conviction.
